calibration.interpretation: Four synthetic controls only. Matching these controls does not validate the judge or establish clinical accuracy.

limits: All 28 cases and the grader v2 prompt match the preceding 445-test run. The four portfolio/coverage/framing cases were introduced in that earlier run, not this rerun. Known development cases, one retained completed sample per case, live-source changes, same-family judging and bounded references limit interpretation. No clinician review. URL membership does not validate a claim. Grader v2 results are not directly comparable with older grader-v1 runs.
